selection_policy: Only after normal NoMatch, veto an automatic abbreviation fallback Match unless existing sample_score is positive or either normalized name equals the full initials or is composed of greedy nonempty ordered prefixes of every delimiter-separated word in the other. Normal matches, ambiguity, rankings, scores, thresholds remain unchanged. Designed by a source-blind agent using only old development/regression corpora. Frozen before exposure to second-tranche cases or predictions.
acceptance: Preserve all correct automatic matches, including renamed ones, and do not increase false automatic matches in the second tranche; no tuning on exposed labels. A zero-change result is evidence of nonregression only, not improved independent accuracy.

supersedes_before_any_predictions.reason: Source-blind code review reproduced a greedy token-prefix bug for invoice_number/in and attribute_type/at. An allocation-free full-initials check restores these valid abbreviations. New public regression failed before correction and passed after. Source integration confirms no second-tranche predictions had run.
